narr: A mid-level disturbance and surface trough draped from western North Carolina into south-central Virginia led to development of scattered to numerous showers and thunderstorms across the northwest Piedmont in the late afternoon. These storms tracked east-southeast during the mid to late-evening hours, tapering off by late evening. The storms over Orange and Durham Counties produced flash flooding around Chapel Hill and Durham.
